title: RTX 4060 Early Benchmarks: Is it even good at "Nivida Approved" Settings (626p Internal res?!?)
description:
Nvidia is allowing the RTX 4060 to have some performance comparisons released early before full reviews are available, but only in Cyberpunk 2077 RT Ultra DLSS Balanced and DLSS 3 Frame Gen on and off. This gives me a chance to give a lot of thoughts about both DLSS 2 and 3 as well as give some initial performance comparisons at these limited settings against the RTX 2060, 3050, 3060, 3060 Ti, and 4060 Ti 8GB. And we can check whether the 4060 even looks good at "Nvidia Approved" settings, lol!
